title: Human Resources Representative
description:
Human Resources

The position holder acts as a trusted proxy for the Country Director for the internal response in Brazil and will be responsible for the day-to-day local HR functions. (Recruitment, selection and hiring, benefits administration, implementation of global HR initiatives)

KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:

Recruitment, selection, on-boarding and benefits.

Prepare, publish and follow up on internal and external job advertisements, on the different recruitment platforms.

Ensure that the corporate recruitment policy and process are consistent across local processes (internal documentation, candidate documentation, references, academic checks, creation of the offer, follow-up, approval…)

Partner with candidates at the different stages of the recruitment process.

Organize, prepare and participate in selection interviews.

Keep the supervisor informed about the recruitment, selection and hiring process of new employees.

Provide HR solutions for new employees: conduct orientation sessions, onboarding and update records with new employees.

Ensure the dissemination and compliance with Organizational Protection policies.

Prepare employment contracts for new local/national employees.

Make additions, changes and cancellations of health insurance for national employees.

Review and validate the monthly payroll (salaries, deductions, tax contributions).

Maintain up-to-date data quality in the HR information system (ORACLE and ADP) for employees.

Provide monthly reports to the Regional office with information on headcount, recruitment, income, expenses, execution of mandatory training, among other KPIs.

Supervise the proper follow-up of the procurement processes for supplies, services and consultancies necessary for the operation of the office in the country.

Provide reports to Finance for the annual vacation agreement.

Keep records of in-person and online employees.

Recommend and implement human resources initiatives, aligned with strategic objectives.

Compensation and Benefits

In collaboration with the Regional Human Resources Director, conduct periodic salary scale reviews and benchmarking analysis to ensure competitiveness in the local market.

Periodically review and update job descriptions with supervisors to ensure appropriate salaries and job requirements for new positions.

Communicate any job or salary changes to employees in a timely manner.

Other Responsibilities

Provide technical support and attention (ORACLE and ADP) to local employees.

Provide local follow-up to the performance management process, ensuring timely execution and completion of the process.

Ensure that employee absences, vacations, sick leave, maternity leave, paternity leave, time off, and other time off are recorded in the HR information systems.

QUALIFICATIONS

Completed university degree (Business admiration, Human Resources or other areas)

Fluency in English, written and spoken.

Excellent knowledge of HR principles, rules and procedures and Brazilian labor legislation.

Computer skills in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word and PowerPoint)

Management of HR information systems (ORACLE and ADP preferred)

GOOD TO HAVE BUT NOT NECCESARY.

Knowledge of Spanish (spoken and written)


EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

3 years of work experience in HR (generalist).

Excellent communication skills at all levels of the organization.

Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.

Ability to solve problems and respond to internal employee needs quickly and proactively.

Familiarity with recruiting on social networks.

High level of initiative and ability to work with little supervision.

Availability and flexibility to travel frequently.

title: Project Manager/Executive Assistant to VP of Engineering (ConnectWise)
description:
We are looking for an Project Manager/Executive Assistant to VP of Engineering to work alongside the VP of Engineering and develop data-driven decision-making processes for the engineering, product, and operations teams.

You will build and maintain metrics, dashboards, and KPI frameworks, turning complex data into clear insights that will guide strategic planning.

This position focuses on analytics, reporting, and collaborating with stakeholder, rather than on direct project delivery.

You’ll have a strong influence on executive-level decisions, gain exposure to cross-functional teams, and help evolve data measurement and observability practices across the company.


Customer

ConnectWise is the world’s leading software company dedicated to the success of IT solution providers. Their vision is to power a thriving IT ecosystem that transforms what’s possible for SMBs and do this by empowering IT solution providers with unmatched software, services, and community to achieve their most ambitious vision of success. The tools being developed are used by IT service providers to automate their activities for small and medium sized businesses (SMBs), such as backup and restore, providing security, and performing administrative tasks on Microsoft 365 tenants.


Project

We are seeking an Project Manager/Executive Assistant to work alongside our VP of Engineering, driving data-driven decisions across engineering, product, operations, and related teams. In this role, you will not be responsible for executing or managing specific project delivery, but rather will build, maintain, and evolve the metrics, dashboards, analyses, and reporting infrastructure that inform leadership’s strategic decisions.

Your core mission will be to provide high-visibility, actionable insights. You will coordinate with multiple teams to collect, validate, and interpret data; propose new KPIs and measurement strategies; identify trends, risks, and opportunities; and present your findings to Senior leadership or directly to the team on monthly business review meetings in a clear, compelling way.

You will act as a force multiplier, enabling the VP and Senior leadership to monitor progress, spot deviations early, and course-correct, while fostering alignment across stakeholders on how success is measured and communicated.


Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in a technical or data-oriented roles (e.g. analytics, reporting, technical product management, program management with a strong focus on metrics)
  • Strong experience working with cross-functional engineering, product, or operations teams
  • Experience analyzing large data sets, identifying trends and anomalies, and performing root cause analysis
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with ability to simplify complex analyses into digestible narratives for Senior audiences
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with ability to influence across multiple teams without direct authority
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • Experience in defining and refining KPIs, SLAs, OKRs, and similar measurement frameworks
  • Advanced level of English


Will be a plus

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, statistics, business analytics, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience in technical domains (e.g. cloud, infrastructure, SaaS, and dev tools)
  • Familiarity with data warehouses, ETL processes, instrumentation, event tracking, observability, and monitoring systems
  • Experience working with program management tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, and Asana)
  • Prior experience reporting to Senior executives or being part of an executive-facing analytics and insights team
  • Prior experience with metrics governance (defining metric ownership, ensuring metric consistency, handling metric versioning, and maintaining metric catalogs)
  • Experience in tooling improvements for measurement (e.g. instrumenting new metrics, automating data collection, and adopting of data-quality tooling)


Personal Profile

  • High level of self-organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Structured work approach
  • Excellent communication skills


Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain dashboards and scorecards to reflect the progress toward strategic objectives
  • Define, refine, and evolve KPIs, SLAs, OKRs, and other metrics frameworks in collaboration with engineering, product, operations, and business teams
  • Aggregate, cleanse, and correlate data from multiple systems (e.g. JIRA, monitoring, data warehouse, internal tools, and financial systems)
  • Analyze trends, variances, and anomalies. Perform root cause analyses, and propose actions or changes to processes or focus
  • Produce regular reports (weekly, monthly, quarterly) for the VP, the executive team, and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Partner with stakeholders to vet and align on metric definitions, reporting cadences, and data interpretations
  • Assist in setting targets, thresholds, and goals for key metrics, and monitor progress toward them
  • Monitor the health of metrics (data quality, signal stability, outlier detection, alerting) and drive remediation when issues arise
  • Identify gaps in current measurement capabilities; propose and drive enhancements, including new instrumentation, tooling, or process changes
  • Serve as the “go-to” analytics/metrics liaison between the VP and various teams (engineering, product, operations, finance)
  • Assist in preparing executive-level narratives and presentations, translating complex data into impactful stories
  • Stay abreast of industry best practices in metrics, observability, dashboards, and data analytics. Implement innovations and continuous improvements

title: Salesforce Director

Pessoa Diretora de Salesforce


Objetivo da Posição

Como uma empresa global de serviços profissionais em tecnologia e transformação digital, buscamos Diretor(a) de Salesforce que terá como missão liderar a evolução e o fortalecimento a divisão de Salesforce, estruturando a operação no Brasil, garantindo a entrega de projetos complexos com excelência e construindo relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros. Trata-se de uma posição que exige visão integrada de negócios, capacidade de gerar novos contratos de forma autônoma e habilidade para estruturar equipes de alta performance em um ambiente de crescimento acelerado.


Principais Desafios e Atribuições

  • Escalar a operação de Salesforce, estruturando processos, equipes e padrões de qualidade, alinhados às demandas de múltiplos setores e soluções da plataforma.
  • Atuar de forma independente na geração de negócios, incluindo prospecção, desenvolvimento de propostas e fechamento de contratos.
  • Equilibrar as frentes de vendas, entrega e gestão de pessoas, assegurando eficiência operacional, margens saudáveis e satisfação do cliente.
  • Ser o ponto focal no relacionamento com a Salesforce, ampliando sinergias locais, iniciativas conjuntas e participação em fóruns estratégicos.
  • Representar a prática com postura executiva, influenciando stakeholders internos e externos, e garantindo a evolução sustentável do negócio.
  • Desenvolver talentos e formar lideranças alinhadas à cultura de alta performance e ao crescimento de longo prazo.


Experiência e Qualificações Profissionais

  • Experiência sólida e anos de experiência, em consultoria de tecnologia, com histórico consistente em projetos e práticas baseadas em Salesforce.
  • Vivência prévia em funções de liderança, seja em unidades de negócio, consultorias, empresas de software ou como cliente corporativo da plataforma.
  • Histórico comprovado em vendas consultivas: prospecção, negociação e fechamento de contratos estratégicos.
  • Experiência robusta na gestão de projetos complexos de transformação digital com Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, MuleSoft, entre outros).
  • Relacionamento prévio com a Salesforce ou atuação em empresas parceiras será considerado diferencial.
  • Formação superior em áreas relevantes (ex.: Engenharia, Computação, Tecnologia).
  • Certificações Salesforce desejáveis (ex.: Technical Architect, Application Architect), mas não eliminatórias.


Habilidades Comportamentais

  • Energia e ambição estratégica: motivação genuína para crescer, liderar e construir legado.
  • Visão integrada de negócios: capacidade de navegar entre vendas, entrega e gestão de pessoas.
  • Liderança com postura executiva: maturidade, clareza e influência em ambientes de alta exigência.
  • Relacionamento e influência: habilidade para construir e sustentar conexões sólidas com clientes e parceiros estratégicos.
  • Resiliência e adaptabilidade: atuação consistente em ambientes complexos, sob pressão e com grandes contratos em jogo.

title: Consultor/a de Presidência
description:
Descrição da vaga

A posição de Consultor(a) de Presidência tem como principal missão apoiar diretamente o(a) CEO na agenda estratégica, institucional e de governança da companhia, contribuindo para o desdobramento e acompanhamento dos principais pilares do plano estratégico, garantindo fluidez na tomada de decisões e na interlocução com os principais stakeholders da organização, incluindo o acionista francês.

Esse(a) profissional atua de forma transversal, com visão crítica de negócio, elevada capacidade analítica e excelente habilidade de comunicação executiva. É esperado que tenha autonomia e senioridade para representar a presidência em fóruns internos, apoiar o alinhamento entre as áreas da companhia, coordenar entregas estratégicas e apoiar a construção de visões integradas sobre o desempenho da organização.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar a presidência na consolidação da agenda estratégica da companhia, atuando como facilitador entre os objetivos corporativos e os principais desdobramentos executivos;
  • Preparar materiais executivos para conselhos, comitês e reuniões de acompanhamento estratégico, garantindo alinhamento institucional e consistência da informação;
  • Coordenar, junto à alta liderança, a governança de projetos estruturantes, assegurando visibilidade, integração e aderência aos objetivos do negócio;
  • Participar ativamente das interlocuções com o acionista estrangeiro, contribuindo com insumos estratégicos, apresentações e análises sobre a operação e seus resultados;
  • Monitorar os principais indicadores estratégicos da companhia, propondo leituras executivas, análises de sensibilidade e alertas para tomada de decisão;
  • Garantir uma visão integrada das informações gerenciais, consolidando dados de diversas áreas em diagnósticos estratégicos e dashboards de performance;

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Suportar o time de auditoria em temas técnicos críticos e na elaboração das demonstrações financeiras de sustentabilidade conforme IFRS-S.
  • Acompanhar e controlar estruturas de ações preferenciais e o mapa de dividendos do grupo.

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +800 municípios em que atuamos. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. title: Government Affairs Senior Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!

Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China!

Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.


About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced Government Relations Manager to oversee our interactions with state and municipal governments and manage relationships with industry associations. This role is critical for building and maintaining effective partnerships that support our organizational objectives and enhance our public policy initiatives.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with state and municipal government officials to advance organizational goals and policy priorities.
  • Monitor regional legislative and policy developments, analyzing their potential impact on our operations and providing strategic recommendations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact with key industry associations, fostering collaborative partnerships and advocating for shared interests.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to align government relations strategies with business objectives, ensuring cohesive integration and compliance.
  • Represent the organization at governmental meetings, public hearings, and industry association events, advocating for organizational positions and strengthening partnerships.
  • Prepare briefings, reports, and presentations for senior management, highlighting opportunities and challenges in state and municipal affairs.
  • Identify and mitigate potential government-related risks, developing strategies to address them proactively.


Requirements:

  • Relevant experience in government relations or a related field, with a focus on state and municipal affairs and association engagement.
  • Proven ability to build and manage relationships with government officials and industry associations effectively.
  • Strong understanding of regional political landscapes and public policy processes.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, capable of articulating organizational positions clearly and persuasively.
  • Demonstrated experience in successfully managing and advocating for public policy initiatives at the state and municipal levels.
  • Bachelor's degree in Public Administration, Political Science, Business, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 30 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Financial Operations Analyst to join our growing finance team. This role is essential to ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and efficiency of our financial operations in Brazil, from end-to-end payment execution and accounting control to tax compliance and audit-ready documentation.

The ideal candidate has a solid background in end-to-end payment processing, a strong understanding of the banking environment, experience with domestic and international transactions (FX payments), and the accounting knowledge required to accurately book and reconcile all financial movements. Additionally, this person will have a solid grasp of withholding tax requirements, the ability to issue service invoices (NFS-e), and a strong focus on internal controls and documentation processes. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic, international environment and collaborate closely with teams in Brazil, Singapore, and Japan.


Key Responsibilities


Accounts Payable and Payment Operations

  • Manage the full accounts payable cycle, including receiving, reviewing, and verifying invoices for accuracy and compliance with company policies.
  • Execute and monitor domestic and foreign currency (FX) payments, including supplier invoices, intercompany transactions, and service fees.
  • Operate banking platforms with accuracy and control, ensuring timely payment execution and proper approval workflows.
  • Track and manage payment terms, proactively resolving discrepancies and maintaining strong supplier relationships.
  • Coordinate with BPO providers and internal stakeholders to resolve payment-related issues and provide regular payment status updates.
  • Review, validate, and process employee reimbursement claims, ensuring policy compliance, complete documentation, and readiness for audits.
  • Support the continuous improvement of payment procedures and contribute to the development of updated policies and standard operating procedures to enhance efficiency and compliance.


Tax and Invoicing

  • Identify, calculate, and control withholding taxes such as IRRF, ISS, PIS/COFINS, and INSS on supplier invoices and service payments.
  • Ensure proper tax treatment and accurate accounting of all transactions, including cross-border payments.
  • Prepare and issue service invoices (NFS-e) for intercompany and third-party transactions in compliance with municipal regulations and internal policies.
  • Support tax reconciliations, documentation, and reporting required for audits and statutory filings.


Accounting, Reporting, and Internal Controls

  • Accurately record, classify, and reconcile all payment transactions in the general ledger, ensuring proper accounting treatment.
  • Support the maintenance of the chart of accounts, including the creation and updating of GL accounts and cost centers.
  • Assist with monthly closing activities and prepare financial reporting packages for submission to the headquarters in Singapore.
  • Support internal and external audit requests by preparing and organizing documentation that meets governance and compliance requirements.
  • Contribute to building and strengthening internal controls, documentation standards, and compliance processes across all payment, accounting, and tax operations.


Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and professional working proficiency in English (CEFR B2 or above).
  • 2 to 3 years of experience in accounts payable, payment processing, treasury operations, accounting, or similar finance roles, preferably in a multinational environment.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian payment processes, tax obligations, and withholding tax requirements.
  • Proven experience issuing service invoices (NFS-e) and ensuring compliance with fiscal requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with FX payments, international transactions, and corporate banking platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Solid knowledge of internal controls, documentation standards, and audit requirements.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional and international teams.


Why Join Us

  • You will be part of a dynamic finance team that plays a strategic role in our company’s expansion and operations in Brazil. This is a unique opportunity to deepen your expertise in payments, accounting, tax compliance, and internal controls while contributing to the growth of a global organization with strong connections to Singapore and Japan.

Objetivo do cargo: integrar o departamento jurídico, com o objetivo de mitigar riscos e garantir a conformidade legal em todas as operações de incorporação e construção. Para isso, são essenciais sólidos conhecimentos técnicos nessas áreas do direito e proficiência em pesquisa jurídica e ferramentas de produtividade. Em termos comportamentais, esperamos um profissional com excelente comunicação, proatividade, organização, atenção aos detalhes e forte capacidade de raciocínio analítico e trabalho em equipe para solucionar problemas no dia a dia dinâmico da empresa.


Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir de forma autônoma processos administrativos e judiciais, assegurando qualidade técnica e alinhamento com as diretrizes institucionais;
  • Elaborar e revisar peças e petições de baixa, média e alta complexidade (iniciais, defesa, recursos e petições em geral) nas áreas Cível, Trabalhista, Consumidor, Tributário, Imobiliário e Urbanístico;
  • Realizar protocolos eletrônicos e acompanhamentos de processos administrativos e judiciais nos sites de Prefeituras, Procon, CRECI, Tribunais e demais órgãos pertinentes;

  • Conduzir processos de cobrança e execução de títulos, buscando recuperação de crédito;
  • Auxiliar na gestão de prazos de processuais, coletando e analisando subsídios (informações e documentos), prestando suporte na gestão de escritórios terceirizados;
  • Participar como preposto ou procurador em audiências ou assembleias, sempre visando a defesa e prevenção dos interesses da Companhia;
  • Interagir com escritórios externos parceiros para alinhamento técnico e condução eficaz dos casos;
  • Avaliar os riscos de perda em processos judiciais e impactos financeiros do passivo, dando subsídios para a gerência na tomada de decisões e provisionamento de valores;
  • Pesquisar e analisar legislações, jurisprudências e doutrinas pertinentes às atividades da incorporadora e construtora, sugerindo melhorias à gerência, bem como garantindo a conformidade regulatória;

  • Organizar e manter atualizados arquivos e sistemas de controle de documentos jurídicos.

  • Conhecimento das normas relacionadas à compra, venda, registro e regularização de imóveis, trabalhista e empresarial no setor da construção civil.

Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.



Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end em Node.js, seguindo boas práticas de arquitetura e padrões de projeto.
  • Criar, documentar e integrar APIs RESTful de alta performance utilizando TypeScript e Express.
  • Projetar e otimizar modelagem de dados em bancos relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL) e/ou NoSQL (MongoDB), garantindo queries performáticas e escalabilidade.

  • Versionar código com Git, adotando workflows (GitFlow, pull requests, code reviews) e boas práticas de controle de versão.
  • Trabalhar com Docker e docker-compose para criar ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção consistentes e reproduzíveis.
  • Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) usando Jest, Mocha ou similares.
  • Implementar mecanismos de cache (Redis, Memcached) e filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka) para melhorar performance e escalabilidade.
  • Monitorar e depurar aplicações em produção utilizando ferramentas como Node Profiler, Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus.
  • Implementar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) para deploy automatizado em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou Kubernetes.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (front-end, DevOps, QA) em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), participando de planning, daily e retrospectivas.



Resquisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com Node.js e TypeScript, aplicando padrões de projeto (Factory, Repository, Dependency Injection) e estruturação modular (Clean Architecture, DDD).
  • Uso de Express (ou NestJS/Koa) para construção de APIs, dominando rotas, middlewares, tratamento de erros e validação de payload (class-validator, Joi, Celebrate).
  • Gerenciamento de pacotes com npm ou yarn, versionamento semântico (semver) e controle de dependências.
  • Testes Automatizados: domínio de frameworks como Jest ou Mocha + Chai, testes de integração (supertest) e uso de mocks/fakes.
  • Escalabilidade e Desempenho: experiência em cache (Redis), filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS) e otimizações de consultas em bancos relacionais (índices, partições).
  • Performance e Debugging: uso de ferramentas como Node Profiler, Clinic.js, monitoramento com Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus/Grafana.
  • Integração Contínua e Deploy: prática com CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) e deploy em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou ambientes Kubernetes.
  • Docker Avançado: criação de imagens otimizadas, multi-stage builds e configuração de docker-compose para desenvolvimento e produção.
  • Banco de Dados Relacional Avançado: MySQL ou PostgreSQL (índices, query profiling, replicação, particionamento).
  • APIs Performáticas e Seguras: experiência com GraphQL (Apollo Server), API Gateway, autenticação/autorização via OAuth2, JWT e versionamento de APIs.
  • Git Profundo: workflows GitFlow, rebase vs merge, cherry-pick e estratégias de branching para times grandes.



Habilidades:


  • Conhecimento em PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter, Symfony): será considerado um diferencial entender boas práticas de desenvolvimento back-end em PHP e migrar/integrações pontuais.
  • Experiência com React (ou Next.js): habilidade para colaborar com o front-end em aplicações isomórficas ou SPA, integrando APIs e estados globais (Redux, Context API).
  • Frameworks Node.js avançados: NestJS (dependency injection, modules, providers), Koa ou Fastify para cenários de alta concorrência.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): conhecimento em Terraform ou CloudFormation para provisionamento de ambientes AWS.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: uso de ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Loki/Grafana, OpenTelemetry para logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: trabalho com Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SNS/SQS, WebSockets (Socket.io) e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Microservices: experiência em decomposição de sistemas monolíticos, deploy independente de serviços, comunicação via mensageria e API Gateway.
  • Segurança: implementação de práticas OWASP (mitigação de SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF), configuração de WAF (Cloudflare, AWS WAF) e auditoria de código.
  • Serverless: desenvolvimento e deploy de funções AWS Lambda em Node.js/TypeScript, integração com DynamoDB, S3 e triggers (SQS, API Gateway).

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Salary = ~30-45k BRL


Company Description

Cubbo is a tech-driven platform that helps business grow. We empower retailers, ecommerce, fintech, banking, direct selling, and multi-level marketing (MLM) companies to deliver faster while reducing costs and increasing customer loyalty. Our platform integrates a crm, warehousing, inventory management, fulfillment, and last-mile logistics into one seamless experience. By managing all carriers and providing advanced tools, Cubbo helps brands scale profitably. Our mission is to give every company in Latin America the power to offer world-class fulfillment, creating long-term growth through speed, reliability, and customer-first logistics.


Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for an Engineering Manager located in São Paulo, Brazil. Our office is based in Pinheiros. The Engineering Manager will be responsible for overseeing engineering projects, managing software development processes, and leading a team of engineers. Day-to-day tasks include project management, integrating various systems, and ensuring seamless collaboration among team members. The role also involves setting goals, monitoring progress, and facilitating technical discussions to drive innovation and efficiency.


Outcomes (What success looks like in year one)

  1. Team Growth & Leadership – Build, mentor, and retain a team of high-performing engineers in São Paulo. Achieve an employee engagement score of 8/10+.
  2. Delivery Excellence – Ensure the team consistently delivers product increments on time with high quality, hitting 90%+ of sprint commitments.
  3. System Reliability – Improve uptime and reduce critical incidents (target: <1% downtime, <2 major incidents per quarter).
  4. Scalable Architecture – Partner with product and leadership to define and deliver a roadmap that scales our platform for 10x volume growth.
  5. Engineering Processes – Implement effective agile practices, code review standards, and CI/CD pipelines to reduce cycle time by 30%.
  6. Cross-Team Collaboration – Establish strong collaboration with product, design, and operations teams in Mexico and Brazil, with positive feedback from stakeholders.


Competencies

  • Technical Leadership – Strong software engineering background, ideally in logistics, SaaS, or high-scale platforms.
  • People Leadership – Proven experience managing and growing engineering teams, fostering career growth, and building culture.
  • Execution Focused – Bias for shipping and iterating quickly while maintaining quality.
  • System Thinker – Able to design and guide implementation of scalable, reliable systems.
  • Clear Communicator – Fluent in English and Portuguese; able to align local teams with global leadership.
  • Founder Mindset – Resourceful, entrepreneurial, comfortable working in fast-moving startup environments.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the use of AI-coding tools.
  • Lead and manage the engineering team in São Paulo (hiring, mentoring, performance reviews, team culture).
  • Drive execution of the product roadmap in collaboration with product and design teams.
  • Establish and maintain high engineering standards: code quality, testing, security, and scalability.
  • Own team ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, retros) and foster a strong agile culture.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for leadership, providing visibility on progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Partner with product leadership to balance speed vs. quality trade-offs.
  • Build a strong engineering culture that attracts top talent in Brazil.

Para isso, temos um time diferenciado, campeão, comprometido e disposto a buscar o que, aparentemente, é impossível.

Já somos a maior empresa de shopping centers do Sul do Brasil e detemos 71% do market share do Estado, o que nos orgulha muito e aumenta nossa responsabilidade junto aos nossos lojistas, consumidores, parceiros e clientes. Sonhamos e realizamos voos altos e vamos continuar empreendendo com muita paixão para realizar sempre mais.

Junte-se ao Grupo Almeida Junior, e faça parte de uma equipe comprometida em transformar sonhos em realidade!

title: Bolsista Doutores Inovando - Grupo Boticário - Projeto Turing
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.


O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.


Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .


Sobre a Oportunidade:


No Grupo Boticário, a busca por inovação sustentável e ciência aplicada à beleza se reflete em iniciativas que unem tecnologia, biologia e propósito. Nesse contexto, o projeto propõe o desenvolvimento e validação de uma plataforma integrada de modelagem preditiva , baseada em inteligência artificial , voltada à avaliação da segurança e eficácia de matérias-primas cosméticas naturais .



Formação Acadêmica:


Doutorado completo Química, Farmácia, Bioinformática, Biotecnologia, Ciências Biológicas, Bioquímica ou áreas correlatas.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.


Idioma: Inglês Avançado (leitura e escrita)


Projeto: Projeto Turing


Principais Atividades:

  • Desenvolver e validar experimentalmente uma plataforma, utilizando inteligência artificial, para avaliação de matérias-primas cosméticas.


Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos

  • QSAR (Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationship);
  • Machine learning;
  • Desenvolvimento de modelos preditivos;
  • Análise de dados;
  • RDKit;
  • Noções de bioinformática;


Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento de técnicas in vitro, biologia celular e molecular será considerado um diferencial.
  • Experiência anterior laboratorial e também com analise de dados.


Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Híbrido (2 a 3x por semana presencial)


Soft Skills : Trabalho em Equipe, Auto Gestão, Pensamento crítico, Criatividade e Ética e responsabilidade, Criatividade.

title: ANALISTA DE QUALIDADE
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Implantar e manter as certificações da unidade.

Suportar o atendimento dos requisitos das normas vigentes através do monitoramento dos requisitos legais aplicáveis e seus resultados para a Motiva Rodovias e seus ativos.

Apoiar o saneamento de irregularidades e reduzir riscos dos processos conduzindo o processo de tratamento de não conformidades, seus resultados e desdobramentos.

Realizar auditorias internas da ISO 9001 (Gestão da Qualidade), ISO 39001 (Segurança Viária) e ISO 14001 (Meio Ambiente), em processos/procedimentos, e tratamento das ocorrências e/ou observações identificadas durante as auditorias, realizando a correta tratativa dos apontamentos junto aos responsáveis (não conformidades e oportunidades de melhoria), monitorando o cumprimento dos prazos pactuados, gerenciando os riscos

associados com ações imediatas e implementação de ações na causa raiz e de abrangência para os demais processos e ativos da divisão de rodovias.

Acompanhar auditorias externas para manutenção e recertificação da ISO 9001 (Gestão da Qualidade), ISO 39001 (Segurança Viária) e ISO 14001 (Meio Ambiente) e ISO45001 (Saúde e segurança do trabalho), tratamento junto as áreas responsáveis das ocorrências e/ou observações identificadas durante as auditorias (não conformidades e oportunidades de melhoria) realizando o monitorando o cumprimento dos prazos pactuados e gerenciamento dos riscos.

Treinar ou dar suporte para todos os colaboradores nos treinamentos pertinentes ao Sistema de Gestão Integrado, conduzindo internamente os cronogramas e execução das auditorias corporativas, pontuais e de certificação.

Prover suporte na implementação de novos processos do SGI e implantação de melhorias junto às áreas, por meio elaboração e aplicação de treinamentos internos, formação de comitês, reciclagens, consultorias externas etc.

Promover melhoria e análise do SGI Consolidando dados de análise crítica, auditorias e abordagens de melhorias de processos, reportando para liderança.

Reportar indicadores de desempenho dos processos da área. Consolidando e analisando os indicadores e reportando para a liderança, propondo melhorias e soluções relativas as obrigações contratuais e outros processos do SGI.

✅ Ensino superior completo em Administração, Qualidade, Engenharia, Gestão Empresarial e ou áreas afins.

✅ Conhecimentos no Pacote Office (Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook), Visio, ferramentas da qualidade;

✅ Conhecimento nas Normas ISO 39001, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001;

✅Ser auditor interno de SGI.

Você se destaca, se tiver:

✅ Conhecimentos em Kaizen,5W1H e LEAN

✅Treinamento de auditor líder.

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

  • Mitigar riscos em negociações com arquiteturas de referência, planos de migração e critérios de sucesso; acelerar a transição de PoC para produção.

  • Cloud & DevOps: Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform), AWS e/ou Azure.

A Kaleido é comprometida em promover um ambiente inclusivo que celebre a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Valorizamos indivíduos de diferentes origens, culturas e experiências, e buscamos criar um espaço onde todos se sintam bem-vindos e apoiados. A Kaleido é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas qualificadas de todos os perfis a se candidatarem.

  • Consistent experience as a Data Engineer or in a related role.
  • Strong knowledge of software development (e.g., Python , Spark, Git, CI/CD, Docker).

Atualmente, a empresa atua como sede regional para a América Central e do Sul, exportando do Brasil para Uruguai, Paraguai, Colômbia e México. Com perspectivas promissoras para a região, a Hyundai Motor Brasil, também conhecida como Hyundai Motor Central & South América, está introduzindo tecnologia de ponta de modelos premiados mundialmente, como o IONIQ 5, e avançando para implementar soluções movidas a hidrogênio junto com ações sociais e ambientais para contribuir com as sociedades onde opera na região. Estamos em busca de talentos que escreverão uma nova página de nossa história com o DNA Hyundai.

title: Gerente de Operações Financeiras
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

O Gerente de Operações Financeiras atuará de forma estratégica na estruturação e execução de operações financeiras da companhia, com foco em emissões de dívida, gestão de caixa estratégico e relacionamento com investidores e instituições financeiras. Principais responsabilidades

  • Estruturar e conduzir operações de mercado de capitais, incluindo emissões de debêntures, bonds e operações de equity (ações preferenciais privadas).
  • Coordenar estratégias de captação de recursos, apoiando a área de Tesouraria na gestão eficiente do caixa corporativo e na busca de investidores.
  • Atuar em estreita interface com Jurídico, Relações com Investidores (RI) e áreas de Planejamento e Tesouraria, garantindo alinhamento técnico e estratégico nas operações financeiras.
  • Suportar a agenda de estratégia de funding e governança financeira, assegurando compliance e alinhamento com o roadmap do IPO.
  • Participar ativamente da relação com bancos, investidores e stakeholders financeiros, representando a empresa em negociações e roadshows quando necessário.
  • Liderar iniciativas que otimizem a performance e a eficiência operacional das frentes sob sua gestão.


Perfil desejado

  • Formação: Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas; pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças será considerado diferencial.
  • Experiência sólida em operações financeiras complexas, mercado de capitais, estruturação de dívida e/ou equity.
  • Vivência prévia em instituições financeiras ou empresas com acesso recorrente ao mercado de capitais (emissões, debêntures, IPOs ou operações estruturadas).
  • Forte capacidade de relacionamento e articulação com áreas pares (Planejamento, Jurídico, RI, Tesouraria) e stakeholders externos.
  • Perfil proativo, técnico e relacional, capaz de conduzir agendas estratégicas com autonomia, mantendo alinhamento e fluidez na comunicação.
  • Desejável experiência anterior em estruturação de operações de ações preferenciais privadas e elaboração de acordos de acionistas.


Competências comportamentais

  • Visão estratégica e capacidade analítica apurada.
  • Comunicação assertiva e habilidade de influência.
  • Autonomia, organização e senso de dono.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambiente dinâmico, de relacionamento intenso e múltiplas interfaces.
  • Alta energia e engajamento com o negócio, valorizando a presença e colaboração presencial.

description:
Sobre a Mobiis


A Mobiis é um ecossistema que conecta soluções SaaS para aumentar a eficiência e promover a inovação na cadeia logística, resultado da união de duas empresas do setor: Fretefy e Pathfind. Utilizamos as tecnologias mais avançadas para oferecer as melhores ferramentas do segmento, trazendo mais eficiência para os processos de nossos clientes e parceiros.


Resumo da função:

Responsável por prospectar ativamente leads qualificados via ligações, identificar oportunidades para os produtos SaaS da Mobiis (TMS, Marketplace de Fretes, APIs, etc.), agendar reuniões ou demonstrações para o time de vendas, e manter o funil de pré-venda saudável.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Realizar ligações ativas para empresas potenciais, especialmente embarcadores, transportadoras, operadores logísticos.
  • Qualificar prospects (identificar dores, orçamento, decisão, timing).
  • Apresentar brevemente soluções da Mobiis, despertando interesse para demos.
  • Agendar reuniões / demos com o time de vendas (closers ou gestores de conta).
  • Registrar todas as interações no CRM (contatos, envio de materiais, follow-up).
  • Manter follow-up constante com prospects ao longo do ciclo inicial.
  • Colaborar com marketing para refinar scripts, mensagens de abordagem e campanhas de outbound.
  • Atingir metas mensais de reuniões agendadas / leads qualificados.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência prévia em função de SDR, Inside Sales ou telemarketing ativo, preferencialmente em vendas B2B ou SaaS.
  • Boa comunicação oral, clareza, persuasão e resiliência ao “não”.
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e disciplinado para seguir processos.
  • Conhecimento ou familiaridade com soluções tecnológicas / SaaS é um diferencial.
  • Habilidade com CRM (uso diário, cadastros, relatórios).
  • Desejável conhecimento prévio em logística, transporte ou cadeia de suprimentos.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Experiência com outbound em empresas de tecnologia ou logística.
  • Inglês intermediário (para eventual contato ou materiais).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas agressivas e adaptabilidade.

title: Loss Prevention Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


ABOUT THE ROLE

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitoring multiple CCTV screens and alarm systems simultaneously;
  • Identifying, investigating, and reporting security breaches or suspicious activities;
  • Regularly inspecting and performing maintenance checks on the surveillance equipment;
  • Recording and storing all the footage captured by the cameras
  • Communicating with law enforcement, security personnel, or building managers when needed
  • Complying with data protection laws regarding the use and storage of CCTV footage
  • Training other stay on the operation of the CCTV system if required
  • Writing daily logs and incident reports
  • Follow protocols for maintaining the security of the CCTV control room and its facilities
  • Conduct regular checks and routine maintenance of CCTV equipment
  • Report any suspicious activities to the security personnel and make necessary records
  • Assist law enforcement authorities in investigations and operations
  • Ensure data privacy is respected and maintained at all times
  • Respond to emergency situations quickly and follow emergency procedures
  • Carry out any other duties as required by management


Requirements

  • Proven work experience as a CCTV Operator or relevant role
  • Knowledge of CCTV and Access Control systems and operations (Digifort, Avigilon,
  • Hiccentral, Nexcode)
  • Familiarity with public safety and security procedures/protocols
  • Ability to work under pressure and make quick decisions
  • Highly vigilant and detail-oriented
  • Good communication skills
  • Ability to sit for long periods of time
  • High school diploma or equivalent is preferred

title: Coordenador Efetividade de Força de Vendas
description:
QUE TAL FAZER PARTE DA #GERAÇÃOACHÉ E CONTRIBUIR COM O PROPÓSITO DE LEVAR MAIS VIDA ÀS PESSOAS?


A potência do Aché se reflete em quem faz o Aché acontecer. A começar por seus colaboradores. São eles que irão nos levar além.


Nos orgulhamos em ser uma das 5 maiores indústrias farmacêuticas nacionais com mais de 6 mil colaboradores e 4 Plantas em todo o Brasil.


Conheça os atributos do Nosso Jeito de Ser que guiam a Geração Aché.

  • Somos s apaixonados pela vida.
  • Inovamos para estar sempre à frente.
  • Cuidamos dos nossos clientes.
  • Inspiramos pelo talento e pela diversidade.
  • Zelamos pela nossa reputação. Ela é inegociável.


Você se identifica com isso e tem interesse em fazer parte do nosso time?

Saiba mais sobre a vaga abaixo e inscreva-se .


Somos Aché.

Somos Potência.


Para esta posição é necessário ter:

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas;
  • Experiência em Efetividade da Força de Vendas ou Inteligência de Mercado;
  • Conhecimento sobre a dinâmica do mercado farmacêutico;
  • Domínio sobre auditorias de mercado (IQVIA e Close-Up) e estudos do setor;
  • Conhecimento sobre métodos estatísticos e metodologias de análise.


Todo este conhecimento vai te apoiar nos seguintes desafios:

  • Liderar o time de analistas, estagiários e assistentes de Efetividade, comunicando de forma eficaz quais as responsabilidades e objetivos de cada membro, e garantir a execução de processos, rotinas e análises com excelência;
  • Intermediar o contato com as áreas de marketing e força de vendas, envolvendo a identificação de necessidades de informações e a melhor forma de provê-las com o adequado endereçamento de projetos e a melhor utilização dos recursos disponíveis;
  • Realizar imersões no campo (equipe de propaganda) para compreender as dinâmicas do negócio e trazer recomendações alinhadas à realidade operacional;
  • Criar e liderar a execução de projetos e análises complexas, definindo prazos, metas e indicadores de desempenho, monitorando o progresso para garantir o cumprimento dos objetivos;
  • Analisar o potencial de mercado dos setores em relação aos produtos promovidos (grade promocional) para auxiliar o time em possíveis mudanças nas estruturas das equipes e ter ganhos de produtividade (maior cobertura e/ ou redução de custos);
  • Assegurar a qualidade das informações entregues aos gestores da força de vendas referentes aos produtos promovidos por cada equipe, para tomada de decisão mais assertiva na qualificação dos médicos (exclusão de médicos com baixo potencial para inclusão de médicos com maior potencial e adesão aos mercados/produtos promovidos);
  • Capacitar a força de vendas em relação à segmentação para assegurar boa qualidade dos dados coletados e efetiva implementação das estratégias;
  • Monitorar a cobertura de médicos potenciais, suas participações de receituário e frequência/sequência de visitas a fim de garantir a efetiva implementação das estratégias da força de vendas;
  • Revisar continuamente os indicadores de desempenho da força de vendas e redefini-los, caso necessário, para que as equipes tenham foco na estratégia de propaganda traçada;
  • Controlar e acompanhar as ações de marketing que são executadas pela força de vendas para garantir que tenham os retornos em participação de receituário e demanda esperados.


Local de Trabalho: Guarulhos inicialmente e posteriormente em 2026 será faria lima.

Modelo: Hibrido (Segunda a Quinta - Presencial) e (Sexta feira - Home Office)

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

The Human Resources Manager plays a pivotal role in partnering with leadership to strategically coordinate the full employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to fostering continuous faculty and staff development. This role is crucial in ensuring successful integration into EAC's unique school culture and actively championing school-wide well-being initiatives.


ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:


Talent Development & Retention

  • Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies and leadership development frameworks.
  • Maintains an accurate database of professional development experiences to inform future planning and ensure equitable allocation of resources.
  • Develops and implements career progression frameworks and provides individualized guidance in career development.
  • Proactively identifies and organizes relevant professional development opportunities (e.g., workshops, speakers, EdCamps).


Attracting & Retaining Talent

  • Manages the advertisement of positions and ensures the revision of job descriptions, interview questions, and tracking the overall hiring process, in collaboration with hiring managers.
  • Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants, reviews resumes, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, checks background on applicants, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested.
  • Assists the Director of Finance and Administration in conducting compensation benchmarking and analysis, and utilizes systems to collect and analyze data on staff development, evaluation, retention, and attrition.
  • Organizes an overall calendar and individual events which recognize and celebrate the commitment of faculty & staff to EAC, fostering a positive and appreciative work environment.
  • Conducts interviews with faculty & staff as part of talent assessment and retention efforts.
  • Supporting performance reviews, tracking goal progress.
  • Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, reviews resumes with an equity lens, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested, promoting a diverse candidate pool.


Supporting a Positive & Ethical Culture

  • Administers employment contracts and oversees the comprehensive onboarding process for all new staff, including a schedule of activities, and facilitates training in child protection and data protection.
  • Provides comprehensive support and resources to foreign hire staff as they settle into life in Campinas and at EAC.
  • Plans and implements outings for staff to support inclusion and celebration of the local culture of Campinas.
  • Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies, leadership development frameworks, and DEIJ best practices.


Compliance and Child Protection

  • Collaborates with outsourced providers to ensure effective monitoring of EAC's complaint channel, facilitating appropriate incident reporting, including CIPA compliance.
  • Develops and delivers appropriate compliance training to staff and ensures the fully compliance with HR related laws
  • Establishes and oversees a robust school-wide system for mandatory child protection training for all EAC staff and third-party providers (liaising with counseling staff and Leadership).
  • Stays abreast of compliance-related laws and best practices in human resources, both nationally and internationally.
  • Proactively proposes and implements policy and procedure enhancements that support ethical behavior at EAC.
  • Develops and implements safer hiring protocols, including enhanced interview processes and comprehensive background, social media, and reference checks.


Wellbeing

  • Recommends a comprehensive yearly plan, in line with the school's strategic direction, articulating meaningful developments in all aspects of staff wellness.
  • Conducts research and benchmarking exercises to ensure EAC's approach to staff wellness incorporates new ideas and initiatives.
  • Establishes mechanisms for regular staff feedback on wellness initiatives, utilizing data to inform continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates with Leadership to research and recommend new benefits for inclusion in EAC's approach to staff wellness.


Health (physical and mental/emotional)

  • Develops, promotes, and publishes a comprehensive yearly plan of offerings and events at EAC that support the health and wellbeing of all faculty & staff.
  • Develops and promotes wellbeing activities for faculty & staff, making use of local resources such as guest speakers and trainers.
  • Acts as a primary resource, providing advice and guidance to staff on personal wellbeing, and sharing awareness of internal and external resources.
  • Serves as an internal consultant for faculty and staff on personal matters, such as stress management and relationships, offering evidence-based strategies and resources to support mental health and wellbeing and foster coping mechanisms.


Other duties, as assigned.


POSITION REQUIREMENTS


  • BA in Human Resources, Psychology, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience
  • HR policies, procedures, and best practices
  • Labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance (including CIPA)
  • HR Information Systems (HRIS)
  • Full recruitment and onboarding lifecycle
  • Compensation, benefits, and benchmarking
  • Professional development and training frameworks
  • Child protection and safeguarding protocols
  • Cultural competence and sensitivity.
  • Languages level requirement: B2 in English and C1 or above in Portuguese


Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Excellent communication (verbal and written)
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities
  • High attention to detail
  • Problem-solving and conflict resolution
  • Interpersonal skills and empathy
  • Confidentiality and discretion
  • Data analysis
  • Adaptability and proactivity
  • Cultural awareness and sensitivity
  • Ability to foster an inclusive and equitable workplace culture.


Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.


EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

description:

Você separa e combina tarefas em fluxos de trabalho eficientes e simples. Você é decisivo(a) e toma decisões de alta qualidade, mesmo com informações incompletas ou diante da incerteza. Você demonstra uma enorme iniciativa em situações difíceis e é excepcional em identificar e aproveitar oportunidades.

Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. title: Preschool Teaching Assistant (maternity cover)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW: 

The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.


Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.


ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:

Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC’s mission and values.

Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.

Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.

Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:


Instructional Support and Student Learning

Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.

Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.

Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.

Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.

Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.


Student Care and Learning Environment

Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.

Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).

Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.

Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.


Operational and School Support

Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.

Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.

Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.

Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.

Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.

Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.

Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed. 


Professional Conduct and Growth

Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.

Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.

Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.

Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.


Additional Responsibilities

Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.

Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school. 

Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.

Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.


Working Conditions

Walk on paths and rough terrain

Lifting backpacks and school materials


Other duties, as assigned.


POSITION REQUIREMENTS:


  • Degree in Pedagogy, preferred
  • Five years experience working with children, preferred
  • PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred)
  • English level required: B2 or above
  • Portuguese level required: B2 or above


Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect
  • Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills
  • Strong professional organization skills


Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.


EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Van Hessen is one of the leading global players in the sourcing, processing and distribution of natural casings, meat products and pharmaceuticals. We process animal by-products from slaughterhouses into high-quality food materials and raw materials for the pharmaceutical industry. Our products are 100% natural and, due to the knowledge and skills of our employees, of a very high and consistent quality. We strive to outdo ourselves every day.


About the role

Manage and coordinate the company's human resources function across subfunctions, such as recruitment, training and talent development, compensation and benefits, organization development, and employee relations, to meet company’s business requirements.


Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the formation of one or more elements of functional strategy through specialist expertise and insights, to ensure that the strategy meets business needs.
  • Explore and develop a detailed understanding of external developments or emerging issues and evaluate their potential impact on, or usefulness to, the organization.
  • Deliver complex analyses of HR data; identify key trends and contribute to the creation of HR insights that enable the diagnosis of business issues, enhancement of employee engagement, and/or improvement of business performance.
  • Implement HR frameworks and tools for recruitment, performance management, development, career and succession planning, compensation and benefits, diversity, employee onboarding and offboarding, and retention of talent, within an area of expertise, to meet business or institution needs and enable the attraction, development, and retention of talent at a sustainable cost. Ensure compliance with specified design principles, internal policies, and external legal requirements.
  • Provide specialist advice on the interpretation and application of policies and procedures, resolving queries and issues and referring very complex or contentious issues to others.
  • Communicate the local action plan; explain how this relates to the function's strategy and action plan and to the broader organization's mission and vision; motivate people to achieve local business goals.
  • Help develop procedures for an area of the organization and monitor their implementation.
  • Deliver a budget for an area of the organization or conduct complex analyses on budget progress in other areas of the organization.
  • Contribute to the development and testing of HR data collection forms or questionnaires in a specific area of expertise to ensure the collection of relevant data in line with defined requirements.
  • Use the organization's formal development framework to identify the team's individual development needs. Plan and implement actions to build their capabilities. Provide training or coaching to others throughout the organization in own area of expertise to enable others to improve performance and fulfill personal potential.
  • Develop and propose own performance objectives; take appropriate actions to ensure achievement of agreed objectives, using the organization's performance management systems to improve personal performance. Or manage and report on team performance; set appropriate performance objectives for direct reports or project/account team members and hold people accountable for achieving them, taking appropriate corrective action where necessary to ensure the achievement of team/personal objectives.
  • Manage workstreams or small projects within a transformational change program, ensuring integration with related projects; use structured change management methodologies to build acceptance of change and embed desired culture and behaviours.


About you

  • Further/higher education in human resources or business discipline, with 5-8 years prior experience in HR role.
  • Experience working within a manufacturing organisation would be advantageous.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to exercise good judgement
  • A team player with a professional and flexible approach to work.
  • Innovative thinking with a passion to make a difference within the HR team and wider business.
  • Proficiency in English, Portuguese and Spanish is essential for this role.
  • A solid understanding of current employment law and HR best practice.
  • Flexible with travelling between our four sites (Paraguay, Brazil, Argentina and Chile) is required.


Location Requirement

You must live within commutable distance of our Barreiros, São José - SC, , Brazil office as weekly onsite presence is required.


If this sounds like a role that you would be interested in, then we would love to hear from you. To apply, please email a copy of your CV in English , along with a cover letter explaining the key attributes that you could bring to the role.


We value the support recruitment agencies provide, however we are unable to accept speculative CV’s from agencies we are not already engaged with.

title: Sr. Strategy Research Manager
description:
About Keeta


Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world , Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!



Know more: Keeta Website


About the Job


Senior Strategy Research Associate


Location: 100% On site - Vila Olimpia, SP


Job Responsibilities：


1. Study the business segments, geographical layout, financial strength, and strategic play of the world's leading food delivery players, form a clear judgment on the global food delivery industry landscape and competitive situation, and propose effective development strategies and competitive strategies based on this judgment to support Keeta management's major decisions on resource allocation, organizational structure, capital operation, etc.


2. Participate in desk research, field research, and strategy formulation for Keeta's expansion into new countries, explore and evaluate the feasibility and implementation path of the company's strategic expansion into new regions, and combine facts and analysis to provide objective judgments on the industry, competition, and operational difficulties in specific countries to assist Keeta management in making decisions;


3. Understand the catering and food delivery industries, gain insight into the laws of industry development, keep close track of new opportunities and new models in related areas such as instant retail and catering SaaS, explore and evaluate the feasibility and implementation paths of new strategic directions to assist Keeta management in making decisions and assist in business implementation. Job Responsibilities:


4. Analyze the restaurant and food delivery industries, identify industry trends, and monitor emerging opportunities in related sectors such as quick commerce and restaurant SaaS. Explore and evaluate the feasibility of new strategic directions to support management in decision-making and business implementation.


Job Requirements：

  • Bachelor's degree or above, preferably in business-related majors such as business administration, finance, accounting, and economics;
  • At least three years of relevant experience in internet strategy analysis, strategic consulting, investment, and investment banking, with research experience in the catering, retail, and food delivery industries preferred;
  • Possess a keen business acumen, structured thinking skills, excellent oral and written communication skills, self-motivation and independent thinking, strong data analysis skills, and extensive project management and teamwork experience;
  • Working level English proficiency (C2).


Highlights：


- Contribute to the foundational growth of the Brazil business from inception.

- Join a core team within a key business unit, gaining a comprehensive understanding of the food delivery industry and enhancing commercial analysis capabilities.

- Work closely with senior decision-makers as part of a high-performing team.

  • Manage the configuration, setup, and maintenance of application-related solutions
  • Mentors other analysts on the team by providing guidance and hands-on solving of complex problems.

Mandatory

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and projects to drive business improvements
